value: Capture CO2 from simulated Martian atmosphere; Sabatier reactor combines CO2 and H2 to produce CH4 and H2O
notes: The abstract describes an Earth-based Mars-analog demonstration, not a deployed Mars production system.
Dual cryocoolers freeze CO2 from the simulated atmosphere before pressurization and methanation.
